description: A class definition for DataDefinition in Drupal's TypedData module, handling data type definitions and their properties.

classes.name: DataDefinition
classes.description: Represents a typed data definition with properties like type, label, description, constraints, and settings, supporting configuration and validation.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new DataDefinition instance with a specified data type.

methods.name: createFromDataType
methods.description: Alias for create(), for backward compatibility.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a DataDefinition object with optional initial values.

methods.name: getDataType
methods.description: Returns the data type of the definition.

methods.name: setDataType
methods.description: Sets the data type of the definition.

methods.name: getLabel
methods.description: Retrieves the human-readable label.

methods.name: setLabel
methods.description: Sets the human-readable label.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the description.

methods.name: setDescription
methods.description: Sets the description.

methods.name: isList
methods.description: Checks if the definition is a list type.

methods.name: isReadOnly
methods.description: Checks if the data is read-only.

methods.name: setReadOnly
methods.description: Sets the read-only property.

methods.name: isComputed
methods.description: Checks if the data is computed.

methods.name: setComputed
methods.description: Sets whether the data is computed.

methods.name: isRequired
methods.description: Checks if the data is required.

methods.name: setRequired
methods.description: Sets whether the data is required.

methods.name: getClass
methods.description: Returns the class used for creating the typed data object.

methods.name: setClass
methods.description: Sets the class for the typed data object.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves the settings array.

methods.name: setSettings
methods.description: Sets the settings array.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves a specific setting by name.

methods.name: setSetting
methods.description: Sets a specific setting.

methods.name: getConstraints
methods.description: Retrieves validation constraints, merging defaults.

methods.name: getConstraint
methods.description: Retrieves a specific constraint.

methods.name: setConstraints
methods.description: Sets validation constraints.

methods.name: addConstraint
methods.description: Adds a validation constraint.

methods.name: offsetExists
methods.description: Checks if an offset exists (BC support).

methods.name: offsetGet
methods.description: Gets a value at an offset (BC support).

methods.name: offsetSet
methods.description: Sets a value at an offset (BC support).

methods.name: offsetUnset
methods.description: Unsets a value at an offset (BC support).

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns all definition values as an array.

methods.name: __sleep
methods.description: Prepares object for serialization, excluding typedDataManager.

methods.name: isInternal
methods.description: Checks if the data value is internal.

methods.name: setInternal
methods.description: Sets whether the data value should be internal.
